lines.say: In one study, men drank a lot after training, about twelve drinks' worth.
Their muscle building dropped by about a quarter, even though they also had protein.
Alcohol also disrupts your sleep, and sleep is when a lot of recovery happens.
And it's empty calories, often with salty snacks on the side.
One or two drinks now and then won't wipe out your progress. Heavy drinking, often, will.
If you drink, eat your protein, drink water, and skip it right after leg day.
